latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of a fully automated content generation pipeline.

- Scrapes trending content from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Reddit using Apify.
- Extracts hooks and post structures, reverse-engineers virality, and generates original scripts, captions, carousels, and threads via Claude (OpenClaw).
- Automatically generates a full weekly content calendar.
- Batch schedules posts for auto-publishing across major platforms (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Twitter/X).
- Tracks generated content performance and closes the feedback loop for continuous improvement.
- Runs autonomously with minimal human input once configured.
